data.narrative:
Andromeda Surgical is a seed-stage biotech company founded by Nick Damiano and Kartik Tiwari that has raised $10M+. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 3 public biotech & health companies (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

The stage-progression method is the applicable triangulation approach given available data. Using $35M as a proxy for total capital deployed and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $88M. The public-comp anchoring method cannot be deployed because Andromeda's revenue is not on file, precluding application of the 8.1x median P/S multiple observed across the three public comparables. A peer-median approach similarly cannot be applied, as no narrow peer set of same-stage or adjacent-stage biotech companies with sufficient datapoints exists.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $74M to $101M, with a median of $88M. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue disclosure—standard for private companies—which prevents multiples-based corroboration, and the lack of granular financial metrics from the identified private peer set. Stage-progression relies on historical multiplier assumptions that may not reflect current market conditions or Andromeda's specific technology and runway profile. Additional diligence on burn rate, clinical stage, and IP defensibility would refine this estimate.
